scope: After all inner gates, evaluate parent, full-refit seeds 42/43/44, and failure-aware checklist on original 514 Train episodes with four common new response draws (seed 617) and extra no-dropout retail. Every trained seed must improve at least one actual benchmark total versus parent, worsen neither generated nor retail totals, parameters/state/evidence, false handoffs or resolved-field requests, and retain no-dropout necessary requests and recovery. Baseline holds only when expected-loss ordering lacks an observed failed mandatory field, cannot hand off or retrieve, and that channel cannot be queried again; otherwise uses the existing checklist. Baseline comparison is required evidence, not assumed weaker.
additionalBaseline: The same retained value parent plus the observable failure stopping rule, to distinguish learning from a simple deterministic stop with identical normal decisions. This is diagnostic and cannot replace failed trained seeds.
gate: After all inner gates, evaluate parent, full-refit seeds 42/43/44, and failure-aware checklist on original 514 Train episodes with four common new response draws (seed 617) and extra no-dropout retail. Every trained seed must improve at least one actual benchmark total versus parent, worsen neither generated nor retail totals, parameters/state/evidence, false handoffs or resolved-field requests, and retain no-dropout necessary requests and recovery. Baseline holds only when expected-loss ordering lacks an observed failed mandatory field, cannot hand off or retrieve, and that channel cannot be queried again; otherwise uses the existing checklist. Baseline comparison is required evidence, not assumed weaker.
devGate: Only if actual Train gates pass: freeze fixed refit/42 and all three seeds, evaluate original generated Dev and 16 shared retail response masks plus public document retention. All seeds must worsen no parent economic total/parameter/state/evidence/safety metric and improve at least one actual total; retain no-dropout required requests/recovery. Compare the failure-aware checklist. No selection of another seed or epoch from Dev. If performance matches the checklist, do not claim an extra benefit of learned values. No Test or frozen 27-source holdout inference.
priorStudy: V1 was rejected on actual Train; no Dev/Test used. V2 changes only the prespecified held continuous-loss tie breaker; all final tensors and batch draws match v1.
